title: Correct potential difference
description: Essential: The student's final answer for U_AB must be -75 V (or equivalent, e.g., -75 J/C).

title: Correct final velocity
description: Essential: The student's final answer for v_B must be 5√10 m/s (or approximately 15.81 m/s).

title: Apply potential difference definition
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the formula U_AB = W_AB / q to relate work and charge.

title: Apply work-energy theorem
description: Important: The solution uses the work-energy theorem (or conservation of energy) to relate work, mass, and the change in kinetic energy.

title: Interpret work sign and direction
description: Important: The reasoning correctly interprets that positive work by the electrostatic force on a negative charge implies movement against the field, affecting the sign of U_AB.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution includes proper unit analysis or explicitly states units for intermediate and final answers.

title: Sign error in potential
description: Pitfall: The student calculates U_AB as +75 V, ignoring the sign of the charge or the meaning of positive work.

title: Kinetic energy formula error
description: Pitfall: The student incorrectly applies the work-energy theorem, e.g., using v_B = sqrt(2W/m) without including the initial kinetic energy.
